hygiene_notes: .editorconfig absent at repo root (only nested copies in crates/, repos/, platforms/, shelf-infra/)
dependabot.yml absent at root; no centralized dependency update policy
README.md content describes a 'shelf' layout, not the actual Rust workspace
CONTRIBUTING.md minimal (8 lines); SECURITY.md substantive (124 lines)
dup_exposure_rationale: Pyron is a 67-crate Rust workspace with 43 phenotype-* crates; sibling phenotye-* libs (bus, dep-guard, request-id) are not currently consumed, creating event-bus / request-id / dep-policy duplication risk inside the workspace itself.
sota_gaps: actix-web referenced indirectly via tracing-actix-web=4 but no actix-web runtime consumer — dead transitive
bifrost-routing and bifrost-routing-backup crates duplicated in workspace
No OpenAPI/AsyncAPI spec generation for agileplus-api (axum) or agileplus-dashboard
No structured workspace-level examples/ or benches/ directory
No Cargo workspace lints ([workspace.lints]) — clippy/rustfmt not centralized
No first-class distributed-tracing exporter wiring (OTLP) — only tracing-actix-web present
phenotype-compliance-scanner and phenotype-security-aggregator defined but no evidence of integrated SBOM/CVE pipeline in CI
Two top-level members named 'Settly' and 'Stashly' (lone dirs at 64B) suggest stale/unmigrated stubs
convergence_rationale: Polyglot Rust workspace spanning web (axum/actix-traced), CLI, telemetry, governance, and infrastructure (67 crates, 43 phenotype-*); pulls together multi-domain concerns into one cargo workspace — fits the convergence cluster rather than a single-stack label.
